verdict.rationale: Semgrep's AppSec Platform is a SaaS with an API and a web app, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question, but the evidence documents no sandbox org or environment. The --dry-run flag only stops scan results from being uploaded to the web app. That is dry-run behavior, not sandbox isolation, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test environment isolated from production data, and any evidence of using it for testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
